messages.content:
The following text was generated by one of these five AI language models:
GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Investing in the training of existing employees allows companies to retain critical institutional knowledge that would otherwise be lost or require extensive time for new hires to absorb. External candidates often spend months familiarizing themselves with company-specific processes and culture, whereas internal staff already possess this foundation and can build upon it immediately through targeted development programs. 
When organizations visibly support the growth of their workforce by offering such training, employees respond with greater loyalty and commitment, resulting in improved retention rates that directly lower the expenses incurred from frequent turnover and rehiring efforts. 
Moreover, the process of upskilling current team members tends to unfold more rapidly and at a lower cost than initiating a complete external recruitment cycle, which involves advertising, screening, interviewing, and onboarding multiple candidates before achieving similar productivity levels.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.

message.content: {"model": "Claude", "confidence": 3, "reason": "Formal, structured paragraphs with precise transitions and business-oriented phrasing match Claude's typical style."}
message.reasoning:
I need to identify which of the five AI models most likely produced this text.

The text emphasizes institutional knowledge retention and the cost-effectiveness of internal training over external recruitment.

The text also highlights employee loyalty and commitment as benefits of internal training, and contrasts the speed and cost of upskilling existing staff against external recruitment cycles.

The formal, balanced tone and complex sentence structure suggest GPT or Claude. I am weighing whether the polished eloquence points to GPT or the more nuanced phrasing of Claude.

Grok and DeepSeek are unlikely candidates. Grok favors casual, direct phrasing, while DeepSeek is typically technical and straightforward. Gemini resembles GPT but often uses more concise language. The formal vocabulary and structured argumentation align most closely with Claude.
